findings.title: Command injection via unescaped fixture paths in shell script construction
findings.description: check_fixtures builds a shell script by f-string interpolating manifest paths into 'if [ -d "{p}" ]...' and runs it via sh -c. Paths containing shell metacharacters execute as commands.
findings.impact: An attacker able to modify tests/fixtures/manifest.json executes arbitrary commands in the container context.
findings.remediation: shlex.quote() the paths, or drop the shell entirely and pass a list argv (e.g. ['test','-d',p]).
